verdict.rationale: Tavily's core operations take natural-language input directly: plain-language search queries, research topics, and crawler `instructions` that are documented as "Natural language instructions for the crawler." Its official MCP server also exposes search, extract, crawl, map and research to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients, so users can drive the product conversationally, and a coding agent can install and configure it from a SKILL.md. missing for 10: natural-language control of account, usage and key management; independent hands-on corroboration of conversational operation; natural-language control of map and extract parameters beyond URLs.
